headline: AI Model Expansion Challenges Proprietary Platforms
summary: A surge in open-source AI models is pushing the boundaries of traditional proprietary platforms, with Clay leading the charge. This trend is reshaping the AI landscape by democratizing access to advanced capabilities and reducing dependency on closed systems.
whyItMatters: It accelerates the adoption of AI across industries by providing more accessible and flexible alternatives to proprietary solutions.
